description: PAID $0.025 USDC (no free tier). Canonical merged wallet risk check for one address: ofac_sanctioned (official US Treasury SDN list: entity, uid, programs), us_gov_seized (DOJ/court cases), exploit_linked (attributed / linked / received funds, with incident and evidence tx), address_poisoning (Base USDC 6h scan), scam, mixer, exchange flags, every label with confidence, source and first_seen, risk_score 0-100 + verdict (MALICIOUS/HIGH_RISK/WATCH/LOW_RISK/UNKNOWN) with itemized reasons and sources. Covered by pass_day ($2) / pass_month ($25).

address.description: Wallet or contract address (EVM 0x, Bitcoin, Tron, or Solana). Example: 0x098B716B8Aaf21512996dC57EB0615e2383E2f96. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
